code_ref: on main at 1cc9a51 (HCR-3) plus this change; the loader fix in embed_mlx._MLXEmbedder._load is required to load these weights at all
machine: Apple Silicon (arm64 darwin, 128 GB), Python 3.11, numpy 1.26.4, mlx 0.32.5, mlx-lm 0.32.2 (scratch install, removed after). Cold load 18.7 s; 7.8 GB resident (unified memory, after the load).
loader_finding: The 8B conversion's config.json has tie_word_embeddings false and the snapshot ships no lm_head.weight; mlx_lm's strict load raised 'Missing 1 parameters: lm_head.weight', so the 8B knob could not serve before this change. The embedder now loads every model with tie_word_embeddings true (it reads hidden states only); the 4B's config was already tied, so its load is unchanged.
method: HCR-3's method (RET-1's recipe) and this PR's count-rule method, unchanged: three corpora copied to temp projects, lean index by bge-small, the high twin by the same build_index inside embed_mlx.using_space. Distributions by eval_floor's helpers inside the space. Floor, gate and band: production recall() with index + index_dir, k=10 (explicit mode). Count rule: the real hook body per prompt, fresh session (hook mode). Clean environment (no ambient HIPPO_* variables), user tier off, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1.

corpora_note.golden: QUA-6 golden corpus, tests/golden_corpus/ (50 memories, 50 body chunks; hard_set.yaml 18 rows; abstention_set.yaml 6 probes). Public.
corpora_note.packs: the CI starter-pack corpus seeded per tests/fixtures/recall_hard_set.yaml's header (22 memories, 65 chunks; that fixture's 32 rows; tests/fixtures/recall_abstention_set.yaml 6 probes). Public.
corpora_note.hippo: this repo's own .claude/memory (108 memories, 272 chunks) with its project-local fixtures (38 rows: 16 single-hop + 22 multi-hop; 11 hand-authored off-topic probes). PRIVATE (gitignored): counts and cosines only, no queries or memory names.

extra_off_topic_probes: HCR-3's 12 generic + 12 adjacent technical probes, unchanged

rationale.floor: Generic off-topic probes top out at 0.357; the lowest on-topic best is 0.4746 (starter packs). 0.40 is 0.075 under that lowest on-topic best, the 4B's placement, and 0.043 over the generic ceiling. Live hard set 34/38 at 0.39 and 0.40, 33 at 0.34-0.38 and 0.41-0.42, 31 at 0.44; starter packs 32/32 up to 0.44, 31 from 0.46.
rationale.gate: No window clears every off-topic best and sits under every on-topic best: one adjacent technical probe reaches 0.4908 on the golden corpus, over the starter packs' two lowest on-topic bests (0.4746, 0.4893). strong 0.50 is the lowest value over 0.4908; with it those two queries are admitted by corroboration and the hard sets are identical for every gate tried. support 0.48 holds the live corpus's adjacent probes at 10/12 (0.42-0.46: 9; 0.40: 8).
rationale.band: Results identical for every band from 0 to 0.005; rows within 0.002 under the floor per on-topic query: 0.61, 0.41, 2.68 (bge-small at 0.60: 1.0, 1.28, 4.84). Default 0.002 unchanged.
rationale.count: band 0.11 is the live corpus's p75 gap (0.1127; doctor allows 0.01 under). No band 0.08-0.12 cut a row. wide 0.12 is the largest margin over the floor that cut none: 0.14 cut one starter-pack row, 0.18 a live row as well.

with_warm_reranker.note: Re-run after HCR-4 (#237) landed, on main at bc1839d plus this change: the same hook-mode measure with the warm reranker (Qwen/Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B) active, as recall_warm_high.serving runs a high-profile call once the reranker has loaded. HIPPO_RERANK_TIMEOUT raised so every call is reranked; a production call that passes the 0.8 s warm bound falls back to the fused order, which is the case the rest of this file measures. So the entry has to cost no row in both orders, and it does.
findings: Entry 0.11/0.12 with the reranker on: hard sets 18/18, 31/32, 26/38 on and off, MRR identical; rows on leaked off-topic probes 85 -> 41 over the three corpora; replay 9.62 -> 9.00 rows per injecting prompt.
wide 0.14 still cuts a starter-pack row with the reranker on.
The reranker itself, count rule off, hook mode: golden MRR 0.956 -> 1.000; starter packs 0.784 -> 0.801; live corpus 26/38 = 26/38 and MRR 0.498 -> 0.473.
